title: Privacy Policy
intro: GnomeVPN is a VPN service built on the Hysteria2, VLESS + Reality and WireGuard protocols. It is designed to know as little about you as possible: we do not collect or store your connection history or the addresses you visit. Below is the full list of what is stored.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body: Only what the service cannot run without. For signing in: your email address, name and a hashed password; if you sign in with Telegram or use the bot, your Telegram id, username and language. To protect signing in: the IP address and user agent of the browser or app behind each active session. For the subscription: the plan, its expiry, your payments and, if you were invited or invited someone, the link between those accounts, so the bonus days can be credited. For devices: the device identifier (HWID) your VPN app sends (unrelated to any advertising ID), the device model, platform, system version and app name; the time each device was last active, which the VPN node reports once a minute; the platform and time of the last subscription refresh; and for WireGuard configs, the country you picked.

noLogs.title: Connection logs
noLogs.body: We keep no logs of your traffic: no connection history, visited addresses, DNS queries or connection contents. For each device we keep only the time it was last active — a single value that is overwritten, not a log. Nodes also count transferred bytes to show your usage in the app.

payments.title: Payments
payments.body: Payments are handled by YooKassa. Card details are processed by the payment provider — we never receive or store them. Our side keeps only the fact of payment, its amount, the subscription period and, if auto-renewal is on, the payment method identifier issued by YooKassa.

storage.title: Where data is stored
storage.body: Account data is stored on servers in Russia. Passwords are kept as irreversible hashes. A device record is kept while the device is in your list, and you can remove it in your account at any time. When a subscription ends, devices stay in the list so nothing has to be set up again after you pay. Deleting your account deletes all of its data, devices and configs; payment records may be kept longer where the law requires it.

thirdParty.title: Sharing with third parties
thirdParty.body: We do not sell your data. Part of it is processed by services the product cannot run without: YooKassa, to process payments; the email provider, to deliver emails to your address; and Telegram, if you sign in with Telegram or use the bot. There are no other recipients, except where disclosure is explicitly required by law.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can request a copy of your data, correct it, or delete your account entirely. Email us at the address below — requests are handled within 30 days.

children.title: Children
children.body: The service is not intended for anyone under 13. We do not knowingly collect data from children.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.body: If this policy changes, the date at the top of the page is updated. Material changes are additionally announced to the email on your account.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.body: For questions about personal data and this policy, write to the address below.

meta.title: Privacy policy
meta.description: What GnomeVPN collects and what it does not: no logs of connections or of the sites you visit. How your email and payments are stored.
